title: Isotropic noise on a product basis function
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability mass function $\pi$, and let $B$ be a finite Fourier basis on $\Omega$ indexed by a finite nonempty set $\iota$, with distinguished constant basis index $0_B$. For $\rho\in[0,1]$, a point $x\in\Omega^n$, and a multi-index $a\in\iota^n$, the expectation of the product basis function indexed by $a$ under the product noise distribution at $x$ is $\rho^{d(a)}\prod_{i=1}^n B_{a_i}(x_i)$, where $d(a)$ is the number of coordinates $i$ for which $a_i\ne 0_B$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
$B$ is a finite Fourier basis indexed by a finite nonempty set
